svg.title: The delegation contract
svg.desc: A five-part working checklist for delegating to an AI agent: the goal and what counts as success; the allowed actions; the protected information; the actions that require approval; and the limits and stop conditions. A footnote adds agreeing the record of what was attempted and what needs a person. A footer marks this as Orange Tomato's proposed working checklist, not a tested safety standard.

text.tspan: A goal tells the agent where to aim. It should not silently decide how far it may go.
when it must stop and ask.
Also agree the record: what it attempted, what it sent or changed,
what remains, and which decisions need a person.
Orange Tomato's proposed working checklist — not a tested safety standard.
